title: 2022年度 第1回検定一次試験 英検4級 リスニング

parts.name: 第1部
parts.description: イラストを参考にしながら対話を聞き、その最後の文に対する応答として最も適切なものを選ぶ形式です。選択肢は音声で放送されます。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Look at my new ring.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Was it a present?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: No.  I bought it.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「プレゼントだった？」「ううん、自分で買ったの」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「50ドル以上」→値段。2「どういたしまして」→お礼ではない。3「かわいいね」→正解。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Hi.  Can you clean this shirt by Friday?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yes.  It’ll be ready on Thursday.

questions.question: What is the best response?
choices: I’d like to have my shirt.
questions.explanation: 「クリーニングは木曜日にはできるわよ」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「それはすばらしい」→正解。2「私のお気に入り」→無関係。3「私のシャツが欲しい」→不自然。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: What do you do, Peter?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I’m a pilot.  How about you?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I teach piano to children.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「子供たちにピアノを教えているわ」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「将来」→無関係。2「楽しそうですね」→正解。3「はい、娘が一人」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Dad, look at those birds.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: They’re pretty.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Are they looking for food?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 鳥についての「食べ物を探しているのかな？」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「やってみる」→無関係。2「お腹が空いた」→鳥の話。3「そう思うよ」→正解。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Your birthday is next week, right?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yes, it’s on Monday.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Will you have a party?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 誕生日についての「パーティーはするの？」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「遅れて来た」→時間。2「うん、新しいカメラ」→無関係。3「ううん、今年はしないよ」→正解。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: You’re walking very slowly today, Steve.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I’m sorry, Mom.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Do you feel sick?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「（歩くのが遅いけど）具合が悪いの？」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「ううん、ただ疲れているだけ」→正解。2「うん、競争だった」→無関係。3「何か食べよう」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Do you want to play video games today?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Can you come to my house at ten?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「10時に私の家に来れる？」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「そのゲーム知ってる」→10時の誘い。2「ううん、勝てなかった」→無関係。3「分かった、また後でね」→正解。
highlights: Can you come to my house at ten?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I need a new notebook.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: OK.  Let’s go to the bookstore.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Where is it?

questions.question: What is the best response?
choices: There’s one on the second floor.
questions.explanation: 本屋についての「どこにあるの？」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「2階にあるよ」→正解。2「すごくいいよ」→場所ではない。3「昨日買ったよ」→本屋について。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Wow, that’s a nice jacket, Mary.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: When did you buy it?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「いつ買ったの？」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「私のお母さん」→人。2「赤と青」→色。3「先週の日曜日」→正解。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Let’s travel to another country next summer.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Great idea.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Where do you want to go?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 旅行について「どこに行きたい？」への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「2週間」→期間。2「中国か日本」→正解。3「スーツケースの中」→無関係。
highlights: Where do you want to go?

parts.name: 第2部
parts.description: 対話を聞き、その質問に対して最も適切な答えを1, 2, 3, 4の中から一つ選ぶ形式です。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Is that a picture of Osaka?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yes.  I lived there when I was younger.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yeah.  My grandparents still live there now.

questions.question: Who lives in Osaka now?
questions.explanation: 「今大阪に住んでいるのは誰？」「私の祖父母はまだそこに住んでいます（男の子）」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「男の子」→若い頃住んでいた。2「女の子」→無関係。3「男の子の祖父母」→正解。4「女の子の祖父母」→男の子の祖父母。
highlights: My grandparents still live there now.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Mom, Sarah’s cat had five babies.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Can I have one?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Let’s ask Dad.

questions.question: What does the boy want to do?
questions.explanation: 「男の子は何をしたい？」「（生まれた猫のうち）一匹飼ってもいい？」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「動物園に行く」→猫。2「ペットの猫を飼う」→正解。3「友達と遊ぶ」→猫。4「店に行く」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: You look tired, Billy.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Did you go to bed late last night?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: No, I got up early this morning to walk my dog.

questions.question: Why is Billy tired?
choices: He went to bed late last night.
He got up early this morning.
questions.explanation: 「ビリーが疲れている理由は？」「今朝早く起きて犬の散歩をしたから」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「寝るのが遅かった」→早く起きた。2「犬を洗った」→散歩。3「走りに行った」→散歩。4「今朝早く起きた」→正解。
highlights: I got up early this morning

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Mom, I need a suit.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I’m going to sing in the school concert next Wednesday.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: OK.  We can go shopping on Saturday.

questions.question: What will the boy do next Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 「男の子は来週の水曜日何をする？」「学校のコンサートで歌う」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「コンサートで歌う」→正解。2「買い物に行く」→土曜日。3「映画を見る」→コンサート。4「ジャケットを買う」→土曜日。
highlights: I’m going to sing in the school concert next Wednesday.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Look at that beautiful boat.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Wow.  Let’s take a photo.  Where’s your camera?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: In my bag.  Where’s yours?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I left it in the car.

questions.question: Where is the woman’s camera?
questions.explanation: 「女性のカメラはどこ？」「車の中に忘れてきた」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「男性のバッグの中」→男性のカメラ。2「車の中」→正解。3「家」→車。4「ボートの中」→車。
highlights: I left it in the car.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: How was your math test, Tom?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Not bad.  There were only ten questions.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Were they difficult?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Eight were easy, and two were difficult.

questions.question: How many questions were on the test?
questions.explanation: 「テストには何問あった？」「10問だけだった」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「2」→難しかった数。2「6」→無関係。3「8」→簡単だった数。4「10」→正解。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Oh no!  My blue pen is broken.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: You can use mine.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: It’s in my locker.  I’ll get it now.

questions.question: What is the girl’s problem?
questions.explanation: 「女の子の問題は何？」「青いペンが壊れてしまった」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「宿題をしなかった」→ペン。2「ロッカーが見つからない」→男の子のロッカー。3「青いジャケットが汚い」→青いペン。4「ペンが壊れている」→正解。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Mom, can I borrow your book about Japanese art?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Do you need it for a school report?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: No, I just like looking at the pictures.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: OK.

questions.question: What are they talking about?
questions.explanation: 「彼らは何について話している？」「日本の美術についての本を借りてもいい？」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「本」→正解。2「美術館」→本。3「旅行」→本。4「学校の図書館」→本。
highlights: can I borrow your book about Japanese art?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Dad, can we have curry for lunch?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: We had curry yesterday.  Let’s have pizza.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I don’t like pizza.  How about spaghetti?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: OK.

questions.question: What will they eat for lunch today?
questions.explanation: 「今日のお昼に何を食べる？」「ピザは嫌。スパゲッティはどう？」「オーケー」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「スープ」→無関係。2「ピザ」→女の子が拒否。3「スパゲッティ」→正解。4「カレー」→昨日食べた。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Your Halloween party is on Sunday, right?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yes.  It starts at 4:30.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I have to go home at six.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: That’s fine.

questions.question: When will the party start?
questions.explanation: 「パーティーはいつ始まる？」「4時半に始まるよ」。

parts.name: 第3部
parts.description: 英文を聞き、その質問に対して最も適切な答えを1, 2, 3, 4の中から一つ選ぶ形式です。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I grow vegetables in my garden.  In summer, I can get many tomatoes.  I use them when I cook.  Sometimes, I give them to my friends.

questions.question: Where does the woman get her tomatoes?
questions.explanation: 「女性はどこでトマトを手に入れる？」「庭で野菜を育てている」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「スーパーから」→庭から。2「友人から」→友人にプレゼントする側。3「両親から」→無関係。4「彼女の庭から」→正解。
highlights: I grow vegetables in my garden.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: My sister’s birthday is on Sunday.  My parents will give her a new smartphone, and I’ll buy her a phone case.  My grandfather will make a cake for her.

questions.question: What will the boy buy for his sister’s birthday?
questions.explanation: 「男の子は妹の誕生日に何を買う？」「僕は彼女にスマホケースを買う」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「スマホ」→両親が。2「ケーキ」→祖父が。3「スマホケース」→正解。4「本」→無関係。
highlights: I’ll buy her a phone case.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I’ll go to Hawaii next Friday for my vacation.  Last night, I took out my suitcase, but it was broken.  I’ll buy a new one tomorrow.

questions.question: When will the woman go to Hawaii?
questions.explanation: 「女性はいつハワイに行く？」「来週の金曜日」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「今夜」→来週。2「明日の夜」→明日スーツケースを買う。3「来週の金曜日」→正解。4「来年」→来週。
highlights: I’ll go to Hawaii next Friday

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yesterday, my mom was in a swimming race.  I went to watch it with my dad and my brother.  We were so happy when she won.

questions.question: Who won the swimming race?
questions.explanation: 「誰が水泳のレースで勝った？」「（母親が）勝ってとても嬉しかった」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「女の子」→母親。2「女の子の母親」→正解。3「女の子の父親」→母親。4「女の子の兄弟」→母親。
highlights: my mom was in a swimming race.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Emily’s friends are going to go fishing this afternoon.  Emily can’t go because she has to get ready for her school trip.

questions.question: What does Emily have to do today?
questions.explanation: 「エミリーは今日何をしなければならない？」「修学旅行の準備」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「釣りに行く」→行けない。2「友人にカードを作る」→無関係。3「旅行の準備」→正解。4「早く学校に行く」→旅行の準備。
highlights: she has to get ready for her school trip.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I like taking photos in my free time.  I often take photos of flowers and trees.  I also take many photos at my brother’s soccer games.

questions.question: What is the boy talking about?
questions.explanation: 「男の子は何について話している？」「フリータイムに写真を撮るのが好き（＝趣味）」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「彼の趣味」→正解。2「美術の授業」→趣味の話。3「好きなスポーツ」→趣味の話。4「兄のカメラ」→無関係。
highlights: I like taking photos in my free time.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I live near my grandparents.  I go to their house after school every Tuesday and Thursday. They often come to my house on Sundays.

questions.question: How often does the girl go to her grandparents’ house?
questions.explanation: 「彼女は祖父母の家にどのくらいの頻度で行く？」「毎週火曜日と木曜日（週2回）」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「週1」→週2。2「週2」→正解。3「週3」→日曜日は祖父母が来る側。4「毎日」→火と木。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Oliver likes cooking.  He makes dinner for his family on Wednesdays.  On weekends, he cooks breakfast and makes cakes.

questions.question: What does Oliver do on Wednesdays?
questions.explanation: 「オリバーは水曜日に何をする？」「水曜日に家族の夕食を作る」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「夕食を作る」→正解。2「朝食を作る」→週末。3「ケーキを作る」→週末。4「レストランに行く」→無関係。
highlights: He makes dinner for his family on Wednesdays.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I’ll go to England next year.  First, I’ll go to London to see some famous buildings.  Then, I’ll watch a soccer game in Liverpool.

questions.question: Why will the man go to London?
questions.explanation: 「なぜ（彼らは）ロンドンへ行く？」「有名な建物をいくつか見るため」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「友人に会う」→無関係。2「有名人に会う」→建物を。3「サッカー観戦」→リバプールで。4「いくつか建物を見る」→正解。
highlights: go to London to see some famous buildings.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: My brother and I often go running after school.  He runs 2 kilometers, and I usually run 3 kilometers.  Tomorrow, I want to run 4 kilometers.

questions.question: How many kilometers does the girl usually run?
questions.explanation: 「女の子は普段何キロ走る？」「私は普段3キロ走る」。
